text:
Jade (Design): quick check-in — uploaded a new slice of the notification preview + channel prioritization UI in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/alerts. please skim, want accessibility + copy + dev feasibility feedback by EOD. Matt (Frontend): looked through — overall 👍. question about keyboard reorder: are we doing drag handles or arrow-reorder? drag is fiddly for keyboard users. Olivia (Accessibility): prefer arrow-reorder with clear instructions + live region announcements. also contrast on the badge color #6a9fbf against white is borderline — need 4.5:1 for body text. Samir (PM): copy question: the current action says `Snooze channel`. Some teams read snooze as ephemeral; should we say `Pause notifications` or `Temporarily mute`? both are fine but want consistency with existing product language. Jade (Design): good call. current product uses `Mute` in channel settings, `Snooze` elsewhere. thinking to use `Pause notifications` in the preview because it's explicit. open to synonyms if accessibility suggests one is clearer. Matt (Frontend): implementation note: arrow-reorder + roving tabindex is easiest. we can expose a handle with `tabindex="0" aria-label="Move channel"` and support `Alt+ArrowUp/Down` to reorder. will emit `aria-live` messages like `Channel X moved to position 2`. Olivia (Accessibility): exact ARIA pattern: use `role="list"` on the container and `role="listitem"` for rows, with the live region separate. e.g. ```
  • Email — Primary
    • ...
``` This avoids cluttering each item with dynamic roles. announce both start/end of reorder. Matt (Frontend): nice. for visual focus, we'll add a 3px high-contrast outline and ensure focus styles aren't removed by global resets. can take the figma tokens for that. Samir (PM): on the preview copy for the channel row: current mock shows `Email • Immediate`. propose `Email — Notifications: Immediate` to make it parseable in SR output. shorter variants ok if contrast isn't impacted. Olivia (Accessibility): `Email — Notifications: Immediate` reads better. also add an offscreen label with `aria-hidden="false"`? don't mix that — instead put visible text and use `aria-label` only when needed. ensure status changes have `role="status"` messages not `alert` so we don't interrupt. Jade (Design): UX tweak: thinking of adding a tiny preview chevron that opens a compact preview flyout showing example payload (subject/first line) — this helps PMs validate thresholds without opening rules. does that feel heavy? Matt (Frontend): compact flyout ok. keep it modal-less and dismiss on `Esc`. codewise we'll render it as a sibling to the list and trap focus when open. small perf note: avoid rendering heavy preview for >20 channels by lazy-loading. Olivia (Accessibility): flyout needs `aria-modal="true" role="dialog"` if we trap focus. otherwise treat as a popup with `aria-haspopup="dialog"` from the chevron. Samir (PM): final on labels: use `Pause notifications` on the control, tooltip `Pause notifications for 1h`, and secondary small copy in the preview `Paused until ` when active. Jade (Design): will update figma with `Pause notifications` and the compact flyout mock, plus the contrast adjustments. assigning to @Matt to prototype keyboard reorder and to @Olivia for quick a11y pass. design-bot: snapshot uploaded to thread: https://bot.redwood/snapshots/1718345600.png :camera_flash: Matt (Frontend): got it — will PR a prototype branch tomorrow. Olivia (Accessibility): I'll run a quick NVDA/VoiceOver pass on the prototype and post results here. Samir (PM): great, thanks all. if there are any unresolved copy nits after the a11y pass let's sync 15m tomorrow. :calendar: Jade (Design): thanks! leaving a few inline comments in figma. :sparkles:
